title: Adaptive binary prefix measurement gives a per-label common reconstruction estimate on correlated outputs
statement_preview_not_a_proof: Every pair of input states broadcast by ONE full-domain channel to two receivers with uniform halftrace error b; every finite tree depth L>=0. One EB pair map has EACH-label halftrace error<=Lb+sqrt(ln2/(2*2^L)), hence fidelity-affinity gap
